content.text: 3. PACK BEARINGS WITH MP GREASE NO. 2

items: Use a pressure bearing lubricator if available.
Place bearings in a handful of grease. Force grease into the bearing until completely filled.

items.text: (a) Using SST, drive in a new oil seal to a depth of 31 mm (1.22 in.).
(b) Apply MP grease No. 2 to the oil seal lip.
